appKey: the same APP_KEY you set in Netlify
cloudflareAccountId: from the Cloudflare dashboard, right-hand side of any page
cloudflareApiToken: a token with Cloudflare Pages: Edit
replicateApiToken: optional: r8_... (used first when set; model google/nano-banana-2)
openaiApiKey: optional: sk-... (used when there is no Replicate token; model gpt-image-2)
